title: All {count} Stickers in Adopt Me
meta_description: Compare Adopt Me Stickers by rarity, obtainment route, cost, availability, tradeability, and animated status for your Profile designs.
intro_md: Stickers decorate sections of your Adopt Me Profile and turn a plain card into something that feels like yours. They come from packs, tasks, purchases, and special activities, with rarity and trade rules that deserve more attention than the cutest face in the pile.
description_md:
## Getting and using Stickers

Open Sticker Packs or complete the named activity to collect a sticker, then place it in a Profile section. The obtainment route and cost belong together because packs can use Bucks, Robux, or activity currencies instead of one shared price.

Availability tells you whether that route is active. An unavailable sticker still exists as a collectible, but its old pack, task, or activity is not an active way to obtain it now.

## Trading Stickers

Check tradeability before offering a sticker. The unlimited starting Profile set cannot be traded, while stickers from purchased packs or individual purchases can follow the tradeable collectible system.

Some task and activity rewards have their own restrictions, so rarity alone never answers the trade question. A Legendary label may look important, but it cannot sneak past a clear No.

## Comparing rarity and animation

Rarity groups stickers from Common through Legendary, but it does not create one universal pull chance across every pack. Different packs and activities use their own reward setup, so compare the named obtainment route instead of applying odds from somewhere else.

Animated is a separate design trait. It tells you whether the sticker moves when displayed and should not be guessed from rarity, price, or artwork.
how_it_works_md: Rarity is the sticker's in-game tier. The obtainment route and Cost explain how it was acquired, Availability shows whether that route is active, Tradeability shows whether it can be exchanged, and Animated identifies moving designs.

faq_json.q: What are Stickers used for in Adopt Me?
faq_json.a: Stickers are placed in Profile sections to decorate and personalize your Adopt Me Profile.
Stickers can come from Sticker Packs, tasks, direct purchases, or named activities. Check the obtainment route and availability because each sticker can use a different method.
No. Tradeability depends on the sticker. The unlimited starting Profile set is not tradeable, while many pack and purchased stickers can be exchanged.

faq_json.q: What does unavailable mean for a Sticker?
faq_json.a: It means the sticker's listed obtainment route is not active. Availability and tradeability are separate, so check both before planning how to get one.

faq_json.q: Do Legendary Stickers always have the same pack odds?
faq_json.a: No. Rarity is a classification, but pull chances depend on the specific Sticker Pack or activity. Do not apply one pack's odds to every Legendary sticker.

faq_json.q: What does animated mean for a Sticker?
faq_json.a: An animated sticker has a moving design when displayed. Animation is separate from rarity and tradeability.

wiki_md: Stickers are collectibles used to decorate sections of your Adopt Me Profile. You can get them through Sticker Packs, tasks, purchases, and special activities, while each item keeps its own rarity, availability, and trade rule. Animated stickers add movement, but animation does not decide rarity or whether a sticker can be traded.
